_comment: One entry per brawler. model = GLB with baked clips (Meshy export). stance = idle posture built by src/idle.js ('ready' holds a weapon in front, 'relaxed' hangs the arms). attackClips = names of clips to play when the brawler is tapped. Add a new brawler by dropping a GLB + portrait and adding an entry here.

brawlers.name: LEON
brawlers.title: The Blaster Kid
brawlers.description: Rapid-fires six controller buttons in a tight medium-range cone. Fragile, but wins by attrition.

attack.name: Button Mash
attack.text: Six A/B/X/Y buttons stream out in a tight cone — 204 damage each.

super.name: Disconnect
super.text: Lobs a controller that blasts an area, then leaves a field that keeps enemies from attacking for 2.4s.

brawlers.name: SANJIT
brawlers.title: Dojo Captain
brawlers.description: Fastest fighter in the game with the quickest reload — he picks every fight, but folds if caught out.

attack.name: One-Two Punch
attack.text: A lightning two-hit combo; the second hit lands a beat later.

super.name: Staff Return
super.text: Hurls his staff over walls; it boomerangs back and hits on both passes.

brawlers.name: TONY
brawlers.title: Varsity Tennis
brawlers.description: Lobs explosive shells clean over walls that blast an area on impact.

attack.name: Lob Serve
attack.text: An explosive shell arcs over cover and detonates in an area.

super.name: Cannon Ace
super.text: A piercing cannon shot that smashes straight through walls.

brawlers.name: KOVACS
brawlers.title: Gym Class Legend
brawlers.description: The biggest healthbar and the slowest legs. His thunderclap pierces everyone in front of him.

attack.name: Thunderclap
attack.text: A stomp that sends a piercing shockwave through a wide cone.

super.name: Seismic Slam
super.text: Leaps forward and slams the ground — a massive shockwave erupts on landing.

brawlers.name: HENRY
brawlers.title: Wilderness Week Survivor
brawlers.description: The hardest single hit in the game off a wide paddle arc that is very hard to miss.

attack.name: Paddle Whack
attack.text: A huge 110° sweep that punishes anyone in reach.

super.name: Portage
super.text: A charging dash that knocks enemies flying — and doubles its punch across water.

brawlers.name: ANDERS
brawlers.title: The Hacky-Sack Captain
brawlers.description: Throws a hacky sack onto a spot — catch it on the way back to reload instantly and make the next throw hit harder.

attack.name: Keep It Up
attack.text: Aim the sack onto an enemy, then catch its return to reload instantly and build a harder-hitting streak.

super.name: Pop Off
super.text: Backflips clear, then spikes the ground he left and blasts everyone there away from him.

brawlers.name: HAMMY
brawlers.title: The Basketball Sniper
brawlers.description: Sinks long-range three-pointers; three consecutive hits set his shots On Fire.

attack.name: Three-Pointer
attack.text: Fires a long-range basketball; three consecutive hits set his shots On Fire.

super.name: Bank Is Open
super.text: Fires a huge basketball that gains power on every wall bounce and sets enemies on fire.

brawlers.name: AYAAN
brawlers.title: Downhill Racer
brawlers.description: Two snow shots that meet exactly where you aim — the further out you point, the wider and lazier the curve that gets them there.

attack.name: Slalom
attack.text: Two snow shots swing off the aim line and meet again exactly where you point. Aim far and they draw one wide arc that passes either side of a body and rejoins on it. Aim close and they braid tight — dense and hard to slip, but it gets nowhere.

super.name: Downhill
super.text: Plants his poles and launches into a two-second downhill run you carve with the stick. Anyone he hits is bulldozed aside, and the run ends in a spray of snow that slows everyone nearby. An icy timer over his head counts it down.
